author: young.onion
title: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS for stationery collection
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾 Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! 🥰 We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! 📓✍️💖 If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. ✨ How to apply: 1️⃣ Make sure you're following us [ @young.onion ]! 2️⃣ Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 👇 3️⃣ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! 📂✨ You can also mail us info@youngonion.in Can't wait to see your cute art! Let’s create something amazing! 🌸💫 Tag a friend who has the perfect kawaii art style! 👇💕
